A permit application filed for 3348 Commonwealth Avenue describes an "existing business expanding into adjacent space" and identifies the proposed establishment type as a "Bar/Coffee Shop." Owner Joe Smaldone has previously discussed a partnership with Charlotte-based Enderly Coffee and preparations for longer operating hours, though no official timeline has been announced.

data.location: 1223 W 34th St, Suite C-200, Houston, TX 77018
data.status: closed its doors on Monday, June 8
data.short_description: The Pho Fix is a Vietnamese restaurant known for pho, vermicelli bowls, slow-simmered broths, and family-inspired recipes founded by Danny Pham. The restaurant announced its sudden closure on social media, closing its doors on Monday, June 8, citing "After much thought and consideration, we have made the difficult decision to close The Pho Fix." The restaurant had been operating at The Stomping Grounds in Garden Oaks after previously opening in Houston's Underground Food Hall in 2021.

data.status: opening expected in early July
data.short_description: Clouds Brewing is a Raleigh-based craft beer brand founded in 2014 that also serves elevated pub fare including burgers, sandwiches, wings, and salads. The brewery announced it acquired the assets and operations of the downtown property at 505 W. Jones Street effective June 1, with an opening expected in early July. The venue was most recently home to Tobacco Road Sports Cafe and features expansive indoor dining, multiple bars, and event spaces.

data.status: will open on June 11
data.short_description: Palermo Argentinian Bistro is a traditional Argentine steakhouse concept offering wood-fired grilled meats, fresh seafood, house-made breads, and an Argentine wine selection. The restaurant's third Manhattan location will open on June 11 at 55 Grand Street in SoHo, owned by founder Orhan Cakir, executive chef Carlos Barroz, and wine director Jorge Albarracin. The opening coincides with the start of the FIFA World Cup, and the venue plans to show tournament matches on televisions and a projector screen.

data.status: an opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Ross Tavern is a corner bar-restaurant concept planning to offer contemporary American fare including bar snacks, chicken wings, soups, salads, and handhelds at a former deli location. According to a permit filing with Community Board 11 for a full liquor license, the venue at 1665 Madison Ave in East Harlem will serve food until 11 p.m. and remain open until 4 a.m. daily. The space will have seating for 40 guests with a maximum capacity of 74 people.

data.status: will open on June 13, 2026
data.short_description: Alla Vita is an Italian restaurant concept from Boka Restaurant Group and award-winning Chef Lee Wolen of Michelin-starred Boka, focusing on handmade pastas, wood-fired pizza, and curated wines and cocktails. The restaurant at 523 Houston Street in Nashville's Wedgewood Houston neighborhood will welcome its first guests on June 13, 2026. The space occupies Wedgewood Village within AJ Capital Partners' 18-acre mixed-use development, with interior design by Kehoe Designs featuring garden-inspired Italian floral elements and warm wood tones.

data.status: will open in Philadelphia's East Passyunk neighborhood at 1515 Passyunk Ave. this fall
data.short_description: Habibi Supper Club is a Lebanese restaurant concept from former accountant Miled Finianos, serving breakfast, lunch, and a weekend supper club with a monthly rotating prix fixe menu. The brick-and-mortar location will open at 1515 Passyunk Ave. in Philadelphia's East Passyunk neighborhood this fall, following the success of Finianos's private supper club events. The interior design, created with Kylie Creative, is described as clean, sleek, and home-like, evoking warmth and Lebanese hospitality.

data.status: opened a new shop in Pearland on June 8
data.short_description: Graze Craze is a fast-growing charcuterie chain offering handcrafted charcuterie boards, picnic boxes, and catering options for corporate events, gifting, and everyday occasions. The brand opened a new 1,440-square-foot shop at 1901 Kirby Drive, Suite 102, in Shadow Creek Center in Pearland on June 8. The location is owned and operated by sisters Marisol de la Fuente and Marlen Gonzalez, who will also conduct charcuterie workshops and wine-pairing events.

data.status: new Spring Einstein Bros Bagels should be open before the end of summer
data.short_description: Einstein Bros Bagels is a national bagel chain offering fresh-baked bagels in over 20 varieties along with cream cheese, coffee, and sandwiches. Per a Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation permit, a new location is set to open at the H-E-B Gosling Market shopping center at 5330 FM 2920 Rd in Spring, with construction underway and slated to wrap up towards the end of July. The estimated construction cost is $350,000, and the brand currently has more than 700 locations across the country.

data.location: 2414 W University Dr, Suite 118, McKinney, TX 75071
data.status: aims to open in early to mid-August, pending permits
data.short_description: Gravy & More is a breakfast-and-brunch comfort-food scratch kitchen concept offering biscuits and gravy, chicken and waffles, omelets, pancakes, burgers, and homestyle entrées. Co-founder Michelle Bezanilla shared that the restaurant aims to open at 2414 W. University Drive, Suite 118, in the 380 Marketplace retail center in McKinney in early to mid-August, pending permits. The approximately 3,000-square-foot location will be the brand's second, following an existing presence in Red Oak.

data.status: targeting a late June debut
data.short_description: Hearsay is a new nostalgic cocktail bar concept from Justin Jordan of Home Hospitality Group, featuring an '80s and '90s retro vibe, a juice-driven cocktail program, and a Korean-inspired menu. The bar will open at 1222 Walnut St. in Philadelphia, with an official opening date not yet announced but targeting a late June debut. The four-story, 18,500-square-foot building also houses three other Home Hospitality Group concepts: Celine, HYO, and Chancellor Room.

data.status: will open later this summer
data.short_description: HYO is a classic Korean tabletop barbecue concept from Home Hospitality Group, located within the same building as Hearsay at 1222 Walnut St. in Philadelphia. The venue will open later this summer behind Hearsay, with guests entering through a phone booth. It is one of four concepts by Justin Jordan's Home Hospitality Group in the building.

data.status: will debut this fall
data.short_description: Chancellor Room is a dimly lit cocktail space described as "where ambiance leads the experience," planned for the second floor of 1222 Walnut St. in Philadelphia. The concept from Home Hospitality Group is set to debut this fall. It is one of four concepts by Justin Jordan in the same building as Hearsay, Celine, and HYO.

data.location: 700 Orchard Lake Rd, West Bloomfield, MI 48322
data.status: an opening date hasn't been announced
data.short_description: Pure Green is a national juice bar chain with over 100 locations offering cold-pressed juices, toast, and oatmeal bowls. Real estate firm Gerdom Realty recently secured a space at The Boardwalk Shopping Center at 700 Orchard Lake Road in West Bloomfield for a new Pure Green franchise debuted by local franchisee George Taylor, though an opening date has not been announced. Michigan locations include Partridge Creek, Birmingham, Rochester, and Novi.

data.location: 714 Washington Blvd, Marina Del Rey, CA 90292
data.status: will open this summer, though the team does not have an exact opening date
data.short_description: Niche Cafe is a Los Angeles coffee and smoothie concept that launched in 2018 as a trailer operating along Abbott Kinney Boulevard, offering coffee, matcha, specialty smoothies, and milkshakes. The brand is planning to open a brick-and-mortar cafe at 714 Washington Blvd in Marina Del Rey this summer, though no exact opening date has been set. The team plans to share more details once an opening date is decided.

data.status: aiming for an August opening date
data.short_description: The Carlyle Club is a new dining concept from owner Steve Gogolab featuring sandwiches, seafood, and steaks with international flavors, with a 72-seat patio at the Reid Murdoch & Co. building on Chicago's riverfront. Owner Steve Gogolab is aiming for an August opening date at 316 N Clark Street; Gogolab previously opened Deliz steakhouse in Wicker Park. The address was previously home to The Kitchen American Bistro, which closed earlier this year.

data.status: closed earlier this year
data.short_description: The Kitchen American Bistro was a restaurant previously operating at 316 N Clark Street in Chicago. The article notes the address was previously home to The Kitchen American Bistro, which closed earlier this year. The space is now being converted into The Carlyle Club by owner Steve Gogolab.

data.status: an exact opening timeline has not been finalized yet
data.short_description: High Noon Brunchery is Georgia's first all-pink café, launched in 2024, serving a Southern-inspired breakfast menu with a signature pink atmosphere. The brand has signed a lease for a 4,000-square-foot space at 2285 Peachtree Road in Buckhead, the former home of Another Broken Egg Café, with relocation plans from its original Douglasville location. Construction details are still forthcoming and an exact opening timeline has not been finalized.

data.status: "We're not closing — we're growing"
data.short_description: High Noon Brunchery's original Douglasville flagship is being vacated due to lease negotiation challenges, with the brand relocating to a new Buckhead location. Co-founder Porche Perryman stated "We're not closing — we're growing," framing the departure as a relocation rather than a closure. No closing date for the Douglasville location was specified in the article.

data.status: will open at 1705 N. American St. inside The Luxe apartment complex
data.short_description: Luna at the Luxe is a returning Philadelphia café concept owned by Sarah Levine-Varisano, offering breakfast, lunch, espresso, artisan-style pizzas, salads, cocktails, wine, and a bottle shop focused on natural and biodynamic wines. The new 900-square-foot location will open this summer at 1705 N. American St. inside The Luxe apartment complex in Fishtown, featuring a 30-seat walnut bar, trellis overhead, and an outdoor courtyard with seating for 40 to 50 guests. Luna originally opened in Old City in 2016; Levine-Varisano sold the original café in 2022 and operated a second location until the lease ended, prompting the relocation.

data.status: targeting an opening ahead of the upcoming college football season
data.short_description: Atomic Wings is a Buffalo-inspired chicken wing chain serving wings, tenders, sandwiches, and sauces. The franchise is opening its first Ohio location at 2112 N. High St. in Columbus, targeting an opening before the college football season, though the project is currently in the design and planning stages. The franchise owner confirmed the restaurant will serve 100% halal, antibiotic- and hormone-free chicken with approximately 15 sauces and a lineup of flavored dirty sodas.

data.status: aiming for a July opening date
data.short_description: Osteria Gilberto is a new Italian restaurant concept being developed by owner Sergio Barbone. It is planned to open at 1224 W Webster Avenue in Lincoln Park, Chicago, with Barbone aiming for a July opening date. Barbone is also the owner of Bakehouse Chicago, with locations in Lakeview, Roscoe Village, and Southport.

data.status: tentatively targeting a July 2026 opening
data.short_description: Le Petit Comptoir Wine & Cheese is a wine-and-cheese concept serving small plates, charcuterie boards, grilled cheeses, salads, baked Brie, and zero-proof options. Owner Alex Lewis is tentatively targeting a July 2026 opening beside Marblehead House of Pizza at 1 Atlantic Ave in Marblehead, though the timeline is still dependent on final preparations and hiring. The concept has been building excitement through weekly wine-and-cheese tastings, pairing events, and educational classes ahead of the grand opening.

data.status: will break ground this fall
data.short_description: The Laureate is a new boutique hotel being developed by Tina McCarthy in partnership with Chad Ingram and Rob Johnston, incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building at 167 Laurens St. along with adjacent property on Park Ave. The project will break ground this fall and will feature a four-story structure with 84 rooms, suites, and extended-stay residences, plus a lobby bar, garden courtyard, restaurant, and bar in the historic bank building. The development prioritizes historic preservation, retaining the Farmers and Merchants sign, original safes, arches, and terrazzo floor.
